din-gratisprodukt.title: Your Free Product
din-gratisprodukt.descriptionHtml:
Have you shopped with us before? Then you get one of the products below for free with your next purchase — which one is decided by the lucky wheel.

How it works: spin the wheel, add your prize to the cart and spend at least SEK 299 more. The code TACKIGEN is applied automatically and the prize costs SEK 0 at checkout. If only the prize is in your cart, it stays at full price until you have added items worth SEK 299.

Valid once per customer, for customers who have placed at least one order with Beaver Store before, using the same email address as on their previous order.
